about.title: About / Team
about.subtitle: System 5/95 is a company founded in 2013, supported by a multidisciplinary team across Japan, the United States, and the international wellness market.
about.body: The website opens with the team because in premium B2B, trust begins with people, origin, and depth. The name System 5/95 reflects the idea of a complete architecture: not a single product, but a system of devices, services, standards, manufacturing, training, and partnership models. Founder Vitaly Golovan develops the brand as a founder-led wellness ecosystem combining 18+ years of therapeutic wellness experience, international development, and practical knowledge of showroom and massage studio formats.

story.title: Japanese Manufacturing at System 5/95
story.intro1: My name is Akio Nakashima. I am responsible for managing the manufacturing processes of System 5/95 in Japan.
story.intro2: For us, manufacturing is not simply the assembly of a device. It is a complete and carefully structured system in which every detail follows its own path: from engineering concept and development to production, quality inspection, service support, and preparation for delivery to the customer.
story.intro3: At System 5/95, our manufacturing process is built around five key areas: design and development, manufacturing, quality assurance, service, and logistics.
story.intro4: Each area plays an important role, because a true Japanese product cannot be created by chance. It requires discipline, precision, responsibility, and constant attention to detail.
story.title2: Every product begins with an engineering idea.
story.body2a: At the design stage, we think not only about the functions of the device, but also about how a person will use it every day: whether it is comfortable, safe, intuitive, reliable, and pleasant to use.
story.body2b: The Japanese approach to development means that form, materials, movement, temperature, ergonomics, and the overall feeling of the product must work together as one complete system.
story.body2c: For us, innovation is not simply about adding new technologies. True innovation must be useful, stable, and natural for the person using it.
story.title3: Turning the engineering idea into a finished product with precision.
story.body3a: The manufacturing department is responsible for turning the engineering idea into a finished product with precision.
story.body3b: In Japanese manufacturing, there are no small details. Even a slight difference in a component, assembly, or user experience can affect the overall quality of the device.
story.body3c: That is why we focus on assembly accuracy, component stability, careful production processes, and consistent results.
story.body3d: Our goal is for every System 5/95 device to meet one clear standard of quality: reliable, thoughtfully made, and worthy of trust.
story.title4: Quality begins at the very first stage.
story.body4a: For us, quality is not just a final inspection at the end of production. Quality begins at the very first stage.
story.body4b: From development to assembly, we evaluate reliability, safety, operational stability, and ease of use.
story.body4c: Every device must not only function properly, but also be ready for long-term daily use.
story.body4d: That is why quality assurance is a separate and essential part of our manufacturing structure.
story.title5: Responsibility does not end at the moment of purchase.
story.body5a: For us, responsibility does not end at the moment of purchase.
story.body5b: We create devices for long-term use, which is why service support is an important part of the System 5/95 philosophy.
story.body5c: Our approach to service is based on the Japanese principle of respect for the customer: a product should not only work well on the first day, but also maintain its reliability, stability, and value for many years.
story.body5d: That is why we offer a 5-year warranty. For us, this is not simply a commercial condition, but a reflection of our confidence in the quality of Japanese manufacturing, the reliability of our engineering solutions, and the durability of our devices.
story.body5e: We want every customer to feel calm and confident when choosing System 5/95. When someone invests in a premium device for daily body care, they should know that behind the product stands a team that takes responsibility for its quality.
story.title6: Made in Japan is not simply a statement. It is a responsibility.
story.body6a: System 5/95 is built on the principles of Japanese manufacturing: precision, stability, reliability, service, and respect for the user.
story.body6b: We believe that a premium device must be thoughtfully created not only technically, but also emotionally. It should inspire trust, feel pleasant to use, and become a natural part of daily self-care.
story.body6c: For us, Made in Japan is not simply a statement of where a product is made. It is a responsibility to every person who chooses our product.
story.body6d: It means attention to detail, quality control, engineering discipline, long-term service support, and the commitment to creating devices that serve beautifully, reliably, and for many years.
story.body6e: The 5-year System 5/95 warranty is an expression of our confidence that Japanese quality should be more than a promise — it should be real support for the customer over many years.

showrooms.title: Showrooms

O cliente descobre a marca através da calma do espaço, da qualidade do equipamento, da experiência pessoal e da sua própria sensação de resultado. studios.title: Estúdios de massagem

Os dispositivos assumem a principal carga terapêutica, reduzindo a dependência crítica de especialistas manual-only raros. Os parceiros recebem protocolos, orientação em vídeo, formação rápida da equipa e ferramentas de controlo de qualidade. Isto ajuda os estúdios a lançar mais depressa, manter um standard unificado e escalar sem perder qualidade de serviço.

moxi.title: Moxi Yoga
moxi.subtitle: Uma direção wellness dedicada onde movimento, calor, recuperação e ritual se tornam uma prática premium refinada.
moxi.body: Moxi Yoga expande a filosofia System 5/95 para além do produto e da massagem. É um formato onde movimento consciente, calor dirigido, recuperação e estética criam uma experiência wellness calma e moderna. software.title: Software + AI

partnership.title: Como tornar-se parceiro

Isto reduz a fricção de lançamento, reforça a diferenciação e apoia um modelo de crescimento sustentável.
